observations.body: The LORD calls Moses up for stone tablets and instruction; elders remain with Aaron and Hur, glory settles, fire appears, and Moses enters the cloud for forty days and nights.
observations.label: Moses enters the cloud for forty days

observations.body: Moses enters the cloud for forty days belongs to covenant sealed in the Sinai trail.
observations.label: Where this sits

observations.body: Exodus 24:12–18 supplies core evidence for the event’s developing sequence.
observations.label: Within the Sinai event

observations.body: Covenant sealing and representative ascent follow the public words without granting the entire assembly the same access.
observations.label: Reading boundary

payload.posture: Read Exodus 24:12–18 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: Moses enters the cloud for forty days belongs to the covenant sealed movement, but its part in the event must remain distinct from the surrounding speech, response, breach, and renewal.
payload.title: Moses enters the cloud for forty days
